note: Driving-state test at the exact completed-frame boundary

note: First instruction after the fixed driving-picture batch

note: SystemTask reached only after the driving loop exits

note: Original A-key handler

note: First export of the optional multiplayer-only segment

note: Builds and resolves the FWTP cell key

note: Calls the Bogas pitch wrapper once per completed driving frame
